original_plan.expected_observation: A selectable result would require all force-response constraints, all five stage qualifications in both directions, registered evaluator admission, and independent numerical confirmation within the remaining budget.
original_plan.fixed_conditions: All original T08 task quantities, solver settings, force programs, directions, seed, timestep, confirmation rules, and budgets remained frozen throughout.
original_plan.hypothesis: The strongest supported mechanism is a symmetric four-tendon structure whose direction-selective tendons remain slack at 0.05 N and become taut by 0.2 N; high E, low density, maximum bending viscosity, 6.5 mm sections, 22 mm routing, and 1.8 mm opposing payout produce the best executed force-response tradeoff.
original_plan.interpretation: The best executed bound result 7b88e8f9ef74e12318a50090992ab65a0651bcda0d2502b53f6db51f479d9c65 passes symmetric low/high/residual, slack-to-taut, stiffness-ratio, tension, and no-contact metrics: low 0.007493969 m, high 0.023165207 m, residual 4.34972e-5 m, ratio 1.75210. It fails low static balance and recovery speed/static balance (0.001435687 m/s). The 6.7 mm/1.6 mm adaptation cebc3ff310f6944729360be86e3bcb34e7c8f774afcb310f847b807097a42970 preserves force-response bounds but worsens recovery to 0.001680884 m/s. The 6.1 mm/1.6 mm reversal 0caa68bbe4e456ebfa86eeb9e2bd8111e67a97219cbac7cd835b87f418cc5b94 improves recovery to 0.001230956 m/s but still fails stability and also violates high displacement (0.026471611 m) and ratio (1.334929). Registered task.protocol.evaluate remained blocked by TASK_PROTOCOL_EVIDENCE_BINDING_MISMATCH for both outer and underlying simulation evidence. Mathematical passive kernels were unavailable and the registered mechanism study required an unavailable explicit frozen grant; no mathematical computation was counted. This finite route closure does not prove impossibility.
original_plan.stopping_condition: Stop when no tested candidate is acceptance-eligible and the remaining four backend solves are the full confirmation reserve, so another two-solve design trial could not also complete the mandated confirmation scope.
original_plan.weakening_observation: The executed best design already shows low-stage static-balance failure and recovery speed 0.0014357 m/s > 0.001 m/s; H9 and H10 did not remove those failures, and H10 additionally lost high-displacement and stiffness-ratio constraints.
